3. EuroAgri Pipeline



Semantic Knowledge Graphs for Precision Agriculture

An open-source data backbone processing high-resolution NetCDF climate data and NUTS2 administrative boundaries to generate granular crop-variety recommendations and disease risk models.
Architectural Pipeline:

Climate Ingestion. Extracts and normalizes massive, high-resolution NetCDF spatial files.
Heuristic Imputation. Calculates missing elemental ground-truth data (NPK) dynamically based on soil texture and organic matter distributions.
Graph Transformation. Converts tabular Parquet “Source of Truth” files into a semantic Neo4j Knowledge Graph across NUTS2 boundaries.


Metagraph Schema







  [GITHUB]




  
    SYSTEM_METADATA
    Processing: Pandas / NetCDF
    Physics Anchor: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith
    
    
    
    FRICTION_LOG: Missing Data
    Symptom: Global datasets severely lacked direct Nitrogen, Phosphorus, and Potassium (NPK) field data.
    Resolution: Engineered a transparent Heuristic Imputation Engine (NPK v01) to estimate critical elemental levels from surrounding soil physics, unlocking the ability to generate granular crop recommendations.

title: Data Engineering & Cognitive BI
text:
4. Net-Load Forecasting (Master’s Dissertation)



Calibrated Uncertainty & Residual-Based Anomaly Detection for the Irish Power System

Investigated the intersection of probabilistic deep learning and out-of-distribution detection to solve the “context blindness” of traditional energy forecasting during rapid Atlantic weather shifts. Processed 10 years of SCADA operational logs and minute-level Met Éireann meteorological feeds.
Architectural Pipeline:

Index Regularization. Built a strict 15-minute chronological spine, deterministically resolving duplicate timestamps and daylight-saving time (DST) shifts.
Probabilistic Forecasting. Replaced classical ARIMA-GARCH models with an MC-Dropout LSTM, producing both point-forecasts and calibrated 80%/95% uncertainty bands.
Residual Detection. Utilized DeepSVDD and One-Class SVMs to flag structural grid anomalies based on the model’s forecast residuals, rather than the raw net-load.


System Architecture







  [GITHUB]
  [DOWNLOAD_DISSERTATION]




  
    SYSTEM_METADATA
    Forecasting: MC-Dropout LSTM
    Anomaly Detection: DeepSVDD / OC-SVM
    
    
    
    FRICTION_LOG: Feature Overfitting
    Symptom: Initial recurrent models trained on 187 exogenous features generalized poorly, achieving test RMSEs >1 GW.
    Resolution: Constructed a three-way wrapper/filter pipeline (Mutual Information + XGBoost + RFE) to compress the space to a 15-feature compact core, dropping RMSE to ~248 MW.

    

    INFRASTRUCTURE_LOG: Temporal Leakage
    Constraint: Standard K-Fold Cross-Validation leaks future data and smears rare grid events.
    Resolution: Engineered a custom, rolling-origin Anomaly-Safe Splitter to enforce temporal integrity and guarantee minimum rare-event densities per validation block.

1. Urban Pulse Engine

District-Level Traffic Orchestration via Reinforcement Learning

The flagship local orchestration engine. This system scales edge computing from single-node detection to macro-grid control, orchestrating 64 independent traffic lanes across a 20-intersection grid without relying on cloud APIs.
Architectural Pipeline:

Digital Twin. Ingests traffic telemetry and maps it to a deterministic spatial logic layer.
Cognitive Validation. Utilizes a zero-shot transformer to validate traffic state vectors.
Active Orchestration. A Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) Agent actively manages light timings to mitigate terminal gridlock.

2. Civic Pulse Monitor (Smart City Ops)



Geospatial Graph Intelligence & Local Llama 3

A privacy-first Smart City architecture running entirely offline. Traditional hazard systems treat civic reports as context-blind rows in a database. Civic Pulse gives them a memory.
The Workflow:
This system federates structured civic logs with unstructured geospatial data. It utilizes local Llama 3 inference to semantically understand a hazard report, and then strictly validates that hazard against a Neo4j knowledge graph to determine true priority.

Live Demo

    Semantic: Ollama Llama 3
    ↓ Strictly Anchored By ↓
    Symbolic: Neo4j Graph DB
    
    
    
    INFRASTRUCTURE_LOG
    Design Decision: Operating entirely offline ensures sensitive civic and geospatial hazard data never leaves the edge node, achieving 100% data sovereignty.

title: Edge AI & Local Inference
text:
3. Eco Sentry: Cognitive Edge Security



The Air-Gapped Cognitive Firewall

Traditional rule-based firewalls are too rigid for modern IoT networks, and sending logs to Cloud SIEMs incurs massive latency and cost.
The Solution:
A local Vector Database (ChromaDB) acts as the memory core, continuously learning traffic baseline patterns. When an anomaly is detected, instead of just blocking it, a local TinyLlama agent analyzes the vector distance to explain why the packet is anomalous in plain English.

System ArchitectureLive Demo










  [GITHUB]




  
    METHODOLOGY_BRIDGE
    Semantic: TinyLlama 1.1B
    ↓ Strictly Anchored By ↓
    Symbolic: ChromaDB Vector Space
    
    
    
    FRICTION_LOG: Hardware Limits
    Constraint: IoT edge nodes possess highly constrained memory overhead.
    Resolution: Utilizing TinyLlama ensures the semantic reasoning engine operates securely within fractional VRAM footprints, allowing ChromaDB to hold priority.

4. Green-AI Cognitive Pipeline



Carbon-Aware Local Agentic Routing

The true cost of Generative AI is power consumption. This architecture replaces heavy cloud APIs with quantized local models to drastically reduce carbon footprint while maintaining strict data privacy.
Key Innovation:
A “Real-Time Energy Router” that physically measures the exact Joules consumed per generated token. The ReAct Agent intelligently switches between Graph (Structured) and Vector (Unstructured) memory depending on the query to optimize compute cycles.

System ArchitectureLive Demo










  [GITHUB]




  
    SYSTEM_METADATA
    Primary Model: Local LLM (Mistral)
    Orchestration: LangGraph Agent
    
    
    
    TELEMETRY_OBSERVATION
    Optimization: By monitoring the hardware's power draw at the thread level, the LangGraph supervisor can terminate reasoning loops that exceed the mathematical Joules-per-token threshold.

title: Cloud-Native & Hybrid Systems
text:
1. Eco Sentry: Cloud Hybrid Route



The “Satellite Command” unit bridging Infinite Context with Deterministic Logic

Traditional vision systems suffer from context blindness, while Generative AI is prone to catastrophic hallucination when making industrial safety decisions. This architecture solves both by hybridizing cloud-scale LLMs with strict graph databases.
Architectural Pipeline:

Vision Proxy. Captures frames and handles API rate limiting, asynchronously uploading feed data to Google Gemini.
Logic Core. Enforces deterministic safety policies using Neo4j and Cypher. It normalizes AI inputs to static hazard nodes and maps them instantly to safety protocols.
Cloud HUD. A Streamlit dashboard bridging real-time local video with asynchronous cloud intelligence updates.


System ArchitectureLive Demo










  [GITHUB]




  
    SYSTEM_METADATA
    Multimodal AI: Google Gemini API
    Graph Engine: Neo4j / Cypher
    
    

    METHODOLOGY_BRIDGE
    Semantic: Gemini (Observation)
    ↓ Strictly Anchored By ↓
    Symbolic: Neo4j (Action)
    
    
    
    FRICTION_LOG: Video Freezing
    Symptom: Synchronous API calls to Gemini blocked the main thread, freezing the security feed.
    Resolution: Engineered an asynchronous "Pulse" architecture, decoupling the video feed from the intelligence loop to manage latency and API costs simultaneously.

2. Carbon-Aware Agentic Scheduler



Multi-Agent Orchestration on AWS Lambda

A distributed system that schedules and executes heavy AI training jobs dynamically based on the real-time carbon intensity of the electricity grid, utilizing serverless architecture to scale down to zero when idle.
Architectural Pipeline:

Grid Telemetry. Ingests live carbon intensity API data to monitor regional power grids.
LangGraph Orchestration. A multi-agent supervisor evaluates grid thresholds and determines optimal routing execution paths.
Payload Execution. Triggers containerized workloads via AWS Lambda once environmental and cost parameters are met.

title: Cloud-Native & Hybrid Systems
text:
3. Serverless AI Pipeline



Sub-100ms Quality Inspection on AWS IoT Core

An enterprise-grade computer vision pipeline designed for high-throughput manufacturing. It bridges factory floor hardware with scalable cloud inference.
Architectural Pipeline:

Edge Ingestion. Factory floor cameras stream localized defect data via MQTT protocols to AWS IoT Core.
Serverless Inference. AWS Lambda triggers a containerized PyTorch model to run bounding-box inference on incoming payloads.
Quality Routing. Results are logged into DynamoDB, triggering downstream mechanical sorting alerts.


System Architecture







  [GITHUB]




  
    SYSTEM_METADATA
    Data Pipeline: AWS Greengrass & IoT Core
    Inference Engine: PyTorch
    
    
    
    FRICTION_LOG: Cold Start Latency
    Symptom: Initial invocations of the PyTorch Lambda function suffered multi-second cold starts, violating the sub-100ms SLA for the assembly line.
    Resolution: Packaged the model inside an optimized ECR container image and utilized AWS Provisioned Concurrency to keep inference instances "warm" during active manufacturing shifts.

title: Data Engineering & Cognitive BI
text:
2. Churn Investigator: Enterprise Risk Radar



Industrial-grade analytics predicting customer churn through friction mapping

A Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture that solves the context blindness inherent in standard analytics. By orchestrating queries across millions of rows and a graph database, it pinpoints systemic enterprise risk before it results in customer churn.
Architectural Pipeline:

Data Ingestion. Ingests 1M+ rows of structured customer interaction data into a localized SQLite repository.
Semantic Extraction. Local Ollama instances process unstructured text logs to extract specific friction events and customer pain points.
Graph Resolution. Neo4j maps relationships between friction events, predicting systemic churn risk through interconnected nodes.


Live Demo







  [GITHUB]




  
    SYSTEM_METADATA
    Orchestration: LangGraph
    Storage: SQLite + Neo4j
    
    

    METHODOLOGY_BRIDGE
    Semantic: Ollama (Observation)
    ↓ Strictly Anchored By ↓
    Symbolic: Neo4j (Decision)
    
    
    
    FRICTION_LOG: AI Hallucination
    Symptom: LLMs tasked with predicting churn hallucinated false correlations on large datasets.
    Resolution: Stripped the LLM of decision-making power. The AI is restricted entirely to translating unstructured text into nodes; the deterministic Neo4j graph executes the final mathematical risk logic.

2. The Operational Empathy Engine



Federated Join: Flight Logs (Hard Data) + Passenger Sentiment (Soft Data)

A “Service Twin” that bridges the gap between operational performance metrics and subjective passenger experience, identifying systemic failures that traditional analytics miss.
Architectural Pipeline:

Hard Data Layer. Processes and indexes structured airline operational logs in SQLite (delays, turnarounds, gate metrics).
Soft Data Layer. Utilizes local Llama 3 to perform rigorous sentiment analysis and entity extraction on unstructured passenger reviews.
Federated Join. A Neo4j knowledge graph aligns the structured and unstructured layers, mapping exact operational metrics to their emotional outcomes.

title: Data Engineering & Cognitive BI
text:
1. Lex-Ghost Architect: Enterprise Resilience



Simulating Infrastructure Threats with Generative AI and Agentic RAG

An end-to-end enterprise resilience platform. This system simulates physical infrastructure damage and orchestrates recovery strategies, empowering decision-makers through an air-gapped “War Room” interface.
Architectural Pipeline:

Disaster Data Lake (ETL). Prioritizes the “EU Data Bridge” to ingest, clean, and mathematically verify “Ground Truth” disaster telemetry.
Threat & Resilience Engines. Employs Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to simulate structural damage, while a PPO Reinforcement Learning agent maps optimal recovery paths.
Resilience Command Center. An Agentic RAG interface embedded within a Streamlit dashboard allows operators to query and control threat simulations in real-time.


System Architect







  [GITHUB]




  
    SYSTEM_METADATA
    Simulation: GANs + PPO (RL)
    Interface: Agentic RAG / Streamlit
    
    
    
    FRICTION_LOG: Ground Truth Verification
    Symptom: Raw disaster feeds contained high noise-to-signal ratios, causing the Generative Threat Engine to hallucinate non-physical damage states.
    Resolution: Engineered the EU Data Bridge as a strict ETL gatekeeper, verifying "Ground Truth" telemetry against deterministic geographic bounds before allowing it into the Data Lake.
